partners.body: Employers across industries rely on TPM for responsive, ethical, and dependable recruitment.

hussein.quote: Throughout our cooperation with TPM – Total Performance Manpower Agency in the Philippines, we have experienced a high level of professionalism, commitment, and responsiveness in providing qualified Filipino manpower. TPM has proven to be a reliable and effective partner, and we highly appreciate their cooperation and continued efforts to meet our staffing requirements.
hussein.title: COO, Emdad Human Resources – KSA

alam.quote: I cannot speak highly enough about how much of a pleasure it was working with TPM as our PRA partner. TPM has been an extremely valuable resource and we couldn't be any glad with the service that it provided. Even more than its great work, our company appreciated TPM's professionalism and constant communication.
alam.title: Consultant, Al Bilad Group – KSA

moagrabi.quote: We have been with TPM as our PRA for many years now, and they have been constantly genuine in our journey towards finding appropriate skilled and professional workers for our company. I'm truly glad to have been associated with their team.
moagrabi.title: Project Engineer, Metal Land World Co. LLC – Dubai

shareef.quote: Our first project with TPM has been a resounding success, from scrutinizing applicants to the whole experience of hiring people, it has been faultless.
shareef.title: Chief Executive Officer, Al Sharif Group

alayed.quote: With TPM, I trust that I'm in good company.
alayed.title: Vice-President, FBC Industrial Company – KSA

reyes.quote: TPM is our first PRA partner and they are always responsive to any queries that we have. They keep us informed and they understand our company and what we want to achieve. I firmly believe that. And anytime that I make contact with them, they let me know that they've received it and they let me know what the next step is.
reyes.title: Principal, Mentari Intercultural School – Indonesia

henaidy.quote: Comprehensive Human Resource System, unmatched service costs, aggressive negotiating and generous giving to a broad cross-section of a recruitment firm are the main attributes separating TPM from other land-based agencies in the Philippines.
henaidy.title: Chief Executive Officer, TAJ Systems Limited Company

qaoud.title: HR Director, New Boy Saudi Arabia Limited

dawasari.quote: TPM provided us with dependable Filipino workers who are the back-bone of our company. It was a right decision to have them as our partner PRA.
dawasari.title: Human Resource Manager, Jadwalean International Company
